title: Flink Fuchsia
description: A clearer Apache Flink dashboard. Live load coloring on the job graph shows how fast data flows between tasks before you read a single number, and the UI is simpler for people new to Flink. Drop-in JARs add custom backend and frontend logic, with no Flink fork or sidecar.

title: FLYT
description: Apache Flink on YTsaurus. Its connectors and formatters, used by 200+ jobs, read and write YTsaurus tables. Its runtime runs Flink clusters on shared YTsaurus compute, not dedicated machines, and their jobs can write anywhere, ClickHouse included. I built the runtime's Python launcher from scratch and the data-metrics module, and contributed to the connectors.

title: Wili
description: Full-stack wishlist app with sharing, Telegram integration. SvelteKit + TypeScript frontend, Go microservices backend. Deployed to Yandex Cloud via GitHub Actions.

title: Modrinthium
description: A de-branded, telemetry-free fork of the Modrinth App (a Minecraft launcher with a rich ecosystem of mods): no analytics, ads, or account requirement, plus modpack installs and auto-updates straight from a hosted manifest URL.

title: PacketPray
description: Minecraft mod that mitigates crash scenarios related to network packets; 2.5M+ downloads on CurseForge.

title: ClinQ
description: LINQ-inspired validation library providing fluent method chains, mappings, dependency checks, and reusable validators.

title: Stoatium
description: A debranded, self-host-configurable build of the Stoat chat client — what VSCodium is to VS Code. Maintained as a patch series over pinned upstream tags instead of a vendored fork.

title: Droply
description: A minimalistic file transfer app using P2P and centralized flows. I focused on the backend (made a cross-fusion between Spring and Ktor frameworks for websockets).

title: TomShelBot
description: Telegram Java SDK wrapper: handlers, modularity (plugin jars), storage, commands, polls, and more.

title: TReports
description: A lightweight bug‑tracking tool used as a free alternative to collect tester feedback.

title: GenericTensor
description: Matrix/tensor calculus — implemented LU and PLU decompositions.

title: AngouriMath
description: Symbolic algebra library — I added a discrete math module and smaller improvements.

title: MxEngine
description: A-from-scratch 3D engine — fixed texture tooling bugs.
